card.name: Inside long drug and medical names
card.fires_on: Partway through long, multi-part drug names and a few long medical words, at the spot where the next piece of the word is highly predictable. Seen in tenofovir disoproxil, cyclosporine, darbepoetin, diphenhydramine and Precautions.
